supporting_observations.claim: Zeek records show repeated connections from WS-BCARTER-01 to the internal proxy on port 8080 during the alert window, including around 13:36, 13:41, 13:45, 13:50, 13:56, 14:01, 14:04, and 14:06 UTC. These records do not identify the external HTTPS destination.

A Kerberos ticket request for ben.carter and a service ticket for WS-BCARTER-01$ came from 10.30.10.24, whereas the workstation's observed address is 10.30.10.22. The evidence does not identify the source host or explain this activity.

A Chrome CONNECT request to drive.google.com was recorded from WS-BCARTER-01 during the review period, before the alert window. Google Drive is not among the listed approved services, but this record does not establish malicious activity or connect it to the periodic connections.

DropboxUpdate.exe ran as SYSTEM shortly after the alert window. Dropbox is not listed as approved, but the record does not show that this process made the connections in question or that it acted maliciously.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage status reports a collection outage from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC for WS-BCARTER-01 winsec and Sysmon data and for proxy data. Thus, process attribution and proxy CONNECT destinations for the alert window are unavailable.
The provided Zeek connection records show traffic to the internal proxy, not the external HTTPS destinations or the processes responsible for the connections.
claims_not_established: The external destinations, URLs, and TLS characteristics of the periodic connections.

Whether the activity involved command and control, data exfiltration, or use of an unauthorized service.
Which host used 10.30.10.24 for the ben.carter Kerberos requests, and whether that activity was authorized.
Whether the observed Google Drive access or Dropbox updater is related to the alert-window connections.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy logs for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including CONNECT destinations, user, status, byte counts, and timestamps.
Obtain endpoint process/network telemetry for WS-BCARTER-01 covering the alert window.
Identify the host assigned 10.30.10.24 and review its authentication and logon activity around 13:46 UTC.
Review DNS and TLS metadata for WS-BCARTER-01 during the window and validate whether Dropbox was installed or authorized.
